native_files.origin: Snapshot of the spyysalo/bc2gm_corpus Hugging Face dataset repo (huggingface_hub.snapshot_download).

contents.README.md: Hugging Face dataset card. Lists feature schema, splits, and the IOB label mapping (0=O, 1=B-GENE, 2=I-GENE).
contents..gitattributes: HF repo attributes (declares parquet as binary).
contents.bc2gm_corpus/train-00000-of-00001.parque: Training split, 12500 sentences, columns: id, tokens, ner_tags.

native_files.relationship_to_jsonl: train/validation/test.jsonl in this folder are written one row per sentence from the corresponding parquet file. The JSONL preserves the parquet schema (id, tokens, ner_tags) verbatim; ner_tags stay as integer indices, not the B-GENE/I-GENE/O strings.

id: Sentence id (string, '0', '1',..). Not a PMID. BC2GM is a sentence-level corpus with no document grouping in this release.
tokens: List of whitespace-separated tokens for one sentence. The corpus is pre-tokenized; punctuation is its own token (e.g. '.', '-', '(').
ner_tags: [0,1,2] -List of integer IOB tags, one per token, same length as `tokens`. 0=O (outside any gene mention), 1=B-GENE (first token of a gene mention), 2=I-GENE (continuation token of a gene mention). The string label mapping is documented in native/README.md under dataset_info.features.ner_tags.class_label.
